rationale: Supported by canonical guidance (MISEV) and program CMC review as a defensible, qualitative compatibility gate; experimentally tractable but technically complex. Recommend moving to the proposed matrixed spike-in–controlled orthogonal experiments to (a) validate spike-in representativeness vs endogenous EVs, (b) verify capture-compatibility and assay sensitivity, and (c) generate short-interval large-animal (NHP) recovery data to close the key translational evidence gap before any regulatory bridging decisions.
